decisions.question: How long should deleted notes stay in the trash before auto-purge?
decisions.context:
The trash never purges and the storage bill doubled: each month of kept trash costs about $20/mo at today's volume.
Support says 85% of restore requests come within 3 weeks of the delete.
30 days: covers that 3-week window (~85% of restores) at ~$20/mo storage.
7 days: cheapest (~$5/mo), but most restore requests would arrive too late.
90 days: covers nearly all restores, ~$60/mo storage.
